units.source_text: 泪水模糊了视线，女人看起来像影子似的浮在眼前。

en.t: Tears blurred his vision, and the woman seemed to float before his eyes like a shadow.

units.source_text: 她仰面躺在地席上，除了脸以外浑身一丝不挂，左手轻轻地搭在中间细而绷紧的下腹。

en.t: She lay on her back on the matting, completely naked except for her face, her left hand resting lightly on the narrow, taut lower abdomen between them.

units.source_text: 一般人要遮没的部分，她那样毫无顾忌地暴露，但谁都毫不在乎露在外面的脸，她却用手巾盖住。

en.t: The parts most people would cover, she exposed so casually; yet the face that no one would mind seeing uncovered, she had hidden beneath a towel.

units.source_text: 显然那是为了保护眼睛和呼吸道的吧，而那对比，更加明显地表示出裸体的意义。

en.t: Clearly it was to protect her eyes and respiratory passages, but that contrast made the meaning of her nakedness stand out all the more.
